# 🔐 Security checklist

- [ ] I did not add secrets, credentials, tokens, or private data.
- [ ] I considered input validation, authorization, and access control.
- [ ] I considered dependency, infrastructure, and deployment security impact.
- [ ] I added or updated security-relevant tests where appropriate.
- [ ] I confirmed this change does not weaken logging, monitoring, or incident response.

<!-- security-checklist:end -->
